name: OtoMAD
summary: Unlike standard "MADs" (which are generally Anime Music Videos focused on narrative or mood), OtoMADs prioritize the audio experience, utilizing hyper-active editing, pitch-shifting vocals, and a specific set of visual effects designed to mimic the beat of the song.
description: Unlike standard "MADs" (which are generally Anime Music Videos focused on narrative or mood), OtoMADs prioritize the audio experience, utilizing hyper-active editing, pitch-shifting vocals, and a specific set of visual effects designed to mimic the beat of the song. The genre is the Japanese progenitor to the Western YTPMV (YouTube Poop Music Video) aesthetic, sharing a similar lineage of transformative remix culture but maintaining a distinct visual identity rooted in Otaku subculture.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Technical precision, collaborative chaos, remix culture, absurdity
